name: exists_isBaseAdapted
summary: Reindex the hyperbolic sum hypSum(p, W) by an equivalence matching the signs; the standard splitting is base-adapted.

steps.claim: An equivalence ε from r to the index set of hypSum(p, W) carrying t to its signs exists (`exists_equiv_of_card_neg`: equal numbers of indices by h and of negative signs by h′). Take W′ = hypSum(p, W) reindexed by ε and A the splitting given by the reindexed identity frame (`splittingOfGram`); it is base-adapted, being the reindexing of the base-adapted removePlanes(p, W) (`IsBaseAdapted.isOrthoIntegral`).
steps.lean:
(exists_equiv_of_card_neg (by simpa +arith) (by simpa)).rec fun ε hε ↦ ⟨(hypSum p W).reindex
  ε.symm hε, splittingOfGram (submatrix 1 ε id) (by simp) h, ⟨.of_eq_submatrix_mul .one ε.symm
  (IsBaseAdapted.isOrthoIntegral (D := removePlanes p W)) (by simp [entrywise, lAdelic, kAdelic,
  iAdelic, Space.ratMap, removePlanes, splittingOfGram, Space.reindex, reindex_equiv ε.symm])⟩⟩
